part.text:
I found the red ball and walked up to it. The robot is now about 20–30 cm away, facing it, and I've called rest.

The ball was off to the left of where the robot started, past a suitcase and some chairs. The robot is now crouched with its motors off.

A person was measuring the distance to the ball with a tape measure in the last camera image. I didn't touch or move the ball.
